name: INDIA MULTI-PAIS WF9 — Post-Call Handler (100% LeadStudio API, sin Sheets)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const d = $('🧱 Build Followup Payload (WF9)').first().json; const body = { type: 'CALL', outcome: d.outcome, callStatus: d.callStatus, durationSeconds: d.duration_secs || 0, notes: (d.notes || '').slice(0, 900) }; if (d.scheduleNextAt) body.scheduleNextAt = d.scheduleNextAt; return body; })()) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO wf_call_followups (phone, lead_id, followup_id, provider, outcome, call_status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $("🧱 Build Followup Payload (WF9)").first().json.phone }}',
  '{{ $("🧱 Build Followup Payload (WF9)").first().json.lead_id }}',
  '{{ $json.followUp.id }}',
  '{{ $("🧱 Build Followup Payload (WF9)").first().json.is_stringee ? "stringee" : "asterisk" }}',
  '{{ $("🧱 Build Followup Payload (WF9)").first().json.outcome }}',
  '{{ $("🧱 Build Followup Payload (WF9)").first().json.callStatus }}'
);
